# Finicky Felicia by Narene Russell

> Finicky Felicia is a children's picture book written by Narene Russell and illustrated by James Scales Jr. It tells the story of Felicia, a little girl who loves sweets and refuses healthy food, especially vegetables, until her family finds a way to help her enjoy eating healthier. The book is for children ages 3 to 8.

This is the official website for the book and its author: https://narenerussell.com/

## About the book

- Title: Finicky Felicia
- Author: Narene Russell
- Illustrator: James Scales Jr.
- Ages: 3 to 8
- Topics: picky eating, healthy eating, vegetables, family
- Paperback: 30 pages, ISBN 9798405203935, published June 16, 2022
- Hardcover: ISBN 9798855615968, Barnes & Noble Press, published September 2, 2023

## About the author

Narene Russell is a mother of four and grandmother of four who has told stories and made up songs for her children and grandchildren for many years. Finicky Felicia is based on her grandson, a picky eater, and on her daughter's creative ways of getting him to eat vegetables, such as baking muffins with zucchini or carrots.
